newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: BNZ sees no point in moving NZ mortgage rate now.
newsitem.headline: BNZ sees no point in moving NZ mortgage rate now.

text.p: The managing director of the National Australia Bank's Bank of New Zealand unit, Gordon Wheaton, said on Thursday he saw little point in adjusting the bank's variable mortgage lending rate at present.
"I don't see much point in moving at this time," he said at a briefing of journalists on the company's half year result.
The big four banks have left their variable lending rate at 9.4 percent while smaller player Countrywide dropped its rate to 8.95 percent on May 8.
